name: guardmark
description: Probe mod with two switchable settings declared through userConfig: a hook toggle and a strictness choice.

hook_block_marker.title: Block the marker command
hook_block_marker.description: Refuse any Bash command that starts with the marker. Turn off only for scripts you trust.

strictness.title: Strictness
strictness.description: What happens on a match: warn only records it, block denies the call.
